investigation_notes.Description: The alert flagged a supposed Vitalis Healthcare logo on vitali-pharmacy.it. The evidence screenshot shows a local pharmacy branded as "VITALI Farmacia" with different wordmark text and a different logo/icon style than the reference Vitalis Healthcare logo, and the page is a simple contact form with visible contact details (email and address) rather than credential collection prompts. The domain is 8 years old and hosted via a Cloudflare IP with a zero abuse score, and no prior related alerts were identified; these factors indicate a low likelihood of malicious impersonation and support a Low Priority classification.
